name: taster
description: Find the AI slop in a frontend, swap each spot for a better pattern, or build a new screen from a taxonomy of patterns.

interface.shortDescription: Diagnose AI slop in a frontend, swap it, or build without it.
interface.longDescription: 88 rules, 85 measured in a real browser, a taxonomy of 122 patterns organized by what the user is trying to do, and a registry of 144 components built on tokens that you copy into your app.
defaultPrompt: Start Taster: ask me whether my site already exists or is new, then take it from there.
Diagnose this site for AI slop and show me every spot.
Swap the slop on this page for better patterns.
Build a landing page for this product without generic AI patterns.
